scope: Actual frozen originalvision QKV A/B R97 NZ vs single-launch streaming Float flash,independent scoped helpers.

bytes.note: the fused PV product returns one Half buffer instead of two FP32 buffers; this is byte accounting, not a measured speedup

512.scope: Float32 NZ score row -> true-4032 unmasked Float softmax -> Half hi + Half lo NZ probability packing, one launch
512.ABI: five GM pointers, args retained by the caller

reduction.order: hardware vcmax + vcadd; not a Torch replay
reduction.vreduce_signature_assumption: vec_reduce_max/vec_reduce_add(mask, dst, src, work, repeat_times, src_rep_stride) with one call over all 64 repeats leaving the row result in dst[0]; confirmed for vec_reduce_add by the executed Round61/62 AdaLN norm, assumed identical for vec_reduce_max (same vreduce family, vcmax registered). Root build/probe is the authority; the author never compiled this kernel.
reduction.partial_ub_slice_operands: s_f[valid_keys] is used as a vector_dup destination so only the 64-slot key tail is written; the project FA patch already passes offset tensor slices to vector_dup (scores[block, 0, 0]).

kernel.scope: one-launch streaming vision flash attention: FP32 online softmax, Half shift estimate, two-Half probability P@V, one final Half cast

math.row_broadcast: explicit per-row vector_dup expansion; no implicit h_* broadcasting is relied on
buffer_reuse: score FP32 tile -> exp tile (in-place h_exp)
PV low product -> rescale row expansion
PV high product -> final quotient tile

host_protocol.formula: max|scaled QK| <= 16384, measured finitely by the caller or bounded by sqrt(d) * max|q| * max|k|

assumptions: h_reduce_max/h_reduce_sum(axis=1) on a (MB,16) tile yields a (MB,) row tensor
Tensor.reshape((n1,MB,16)) is a metadata view of the same flat UB buffer
masked vector_dup(repeat_times=n1, blk_stride=1, rep_stride=2*MB) writes one 16-value NZ row slot per group
Scalar.set_as(<UB element>) is a legal UB-to-scalar load
h_reduce_sum on Float compiles to Float vcadd; h_max to Float vmax
the Half shift estimate uses Half vcmax (Float vcmax is unsupported here)
vector_dup(mask,dst,scalar,1,1,1) with an explicit repeat slice fills exactly one repeat
in-place same-shape h_sub/h_mul/h_add/h_exp with dst==src0 is supported
a Float UB buffer can be reused sequentially (score->exp, Half score->P_hi, row expansion->widened P_hi) without an explicit alias API
